units.title: Verify: Success feedback targets its own test id unit tests

tests.name: ContributionSheet inline feedback tests > Given a successful send, when the idea is submitted, then it shows the success status and no alert
tests.title: Shows the success status and no alert after a successful send
tests.scenario: Given a successful send, when the idea is submitted, then it shows the success status (queried by test id) and no alert

tests.name: ContributionSheet inline feedback tests > Given the server answers 429, when the idea is submitted, then it shows the slow-down alert and no status
tests.title: Shows the slow-down alert and no success status when the server answers 429
tests.scenario: Given the server answers 429, when the idea is submitted, then it shows the slow-down alert and no success status (queried by test id)

tests.name: ContributionSheet inline feedback tests > Given a successful send, when the player edits the idea, then the success status is cleared
tests.title: Clears the success status when the player edits the idea
tests.scenario: Given a successful send, when the player edits the idea, then the success status is cleared (queried by test id)

units.title: Verify: History error alert and Retry unit tests

tests.name: error shows the error test id and Retry, and Retry returns to loading
tests.title: error shows the error test id and Retry, and Retry returns to loading
tests.scenario: Given listMine rejects once and the retry never settles; When the sheet opens and Retry is clicked; Then the history error test id and Retry button appear first, then the loading test id is shown and listMine has been called twice
tests.detail: Passed on first run. Existing behaviour already satisfies it, so no failing-first step was observed.

tests.name: Retry reloads and recovers
tests.title: Retry reloads and recovers
tests.scenario: Given the first listMine call rejects and the second returns a suggestion; When Retry is clicked; Then the suggestion is shown and Retry is gone
tests.detail: Existing test in the same file, run as part of the file.

tests.name: no Retry when ready
tests.title: no Retry when ready
tests.scenario: Given listMine resolves with an empty list; When the sheet opens; Then no loading, error or Retry is shown
tests.detail: Existing test in the same file, run as part of the file.
